# dctx

> Turn a codebase into focused context for AI assistants. Pack a project, find symbols and read exact source locally. Stable output helps prompt caches reuse context.

dctx 1.2.0: a Rust CLI and MCP server; Apache-2.0; offline, no telemetry. Short: https://www.dctx.internet.technology/llms-small.txt

## Docs
- [Why dctx](https://www.dctx.internet.technology/why/index.md): why it exists; why byte-identical output matters
- [README](https://www.dctx.internet.technology/docs/readme/index.md): install, quick start, map mode
- [Specification](https://www.dctx.internet.technology/docs/spec/index.md): constraints and roadmap
- [Map mode](https://www.dctx.internet.technology/docs/map-mode/index.md): every map verb
